The '''Moff''' of the [[Truum sector/Legends|Truum sector]] was an individual loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Moff was forced to accept [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum's]] [[Contruum rebellion|independence]] from the Empire.<ref name="Strongholds" />
